name: group_history_list_contexts
description: List directly authorized group history contexts for the active task input. References are frozen for this input; only controlled group-history reads enforce inherited source restrictions. No arbitrary destination or user identity may be supplied.

name: group_history_read_messages
description: Request bounded text-only history from a listed context_ref. Returns a query_id; pending is not completion. Continue polling group_history_get_query until completed or failed before ending the task; ending the active input revokes this query access. No files or automatic thread expansion. Range [start_ms,end_ms) has a fixed cutoff; WeCom permits only the recent 7 days, other supported providers allow older ranges. Limit is at most 50. Shared-history restrictions do not enforce general shell or external MCP data-loss prevention.

name: group_history_get_query
description: Read a query page for this exact active input, or request its next page with next=true. Pending is not success: keep polling this query before ending the task. Provider cursors remain server-side. Each read rechecks policy, execution and inherited source permissions; revocation may deny even a cached page.
